title: Reset a member password by one-use code
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · The owner checks identity out of band and issues a short-lived six-digit reset code. The member enters it with CodeSlots and sets their own password on the paired server.

**Verify** · Exercise replaced, expired, used and revoked codes and interrupted submission. Check prior sessions are revoked and another member is unaffected.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-064, WI-065

**Queue** · Follows WI-066 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
evidence: The owner issued a six-digit reset code; the member used CodeSlots, set a new password and signed in. Prior sessions were revoked and another member was unaffected.
